claims.claim: The item is a DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black solar panel/solar module with a junction/port area and watermark text “LUMETT SOLAR ENERGY NIG.” No torch is shown.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly.
claims.evidence: Photos only show close-up appearance of the solar module; no functional test (output under sun, charging performance) is shown.
No receipt/warranty documents are shown in the witness report.
No torch or usage setup is shown; suitability depends on the actual device and specs not visible.

risks.risk: Mismatch of item: seller describes a rechargeable LED torch, but photos show a solar panel/module; wrong item risk affects value heavily.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the exact product being sold (torch + model label) OR a clear photo/video showing the solar panel’s full label/specs and that it is the intended item.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a solar module only (worst-case: unknown wattage/condition) and treat as untested.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/ratings (watts, voltage, amperage) and whether it is foldable vs rigid; this drives compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: One shot of the label/sticker with electrical ratings (watts/voltage/current) and a shot showing the full panel layout/dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for an unverified/unknown-capacity portable solar module.

risks.risk: Condition not fully visible (scratches, cracks, delamination, water damage) beyond partial close-ups.
risks.proof: Full front and back photos plus close-ups of edges/corners and the junction/port area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/used-worn risk (worst-case: possible reduced performance).

risks.risk: No proof of working output; solar modules can look fine but underperform.
risks.proof: A working test clip: measure output under sunlight (e.g., multimeter reading) or show charging a known battery/controller with a visible meter/app.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a functional output test is provided.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/compatibility (controller/inverter, cables, connectors) and whether it can charge a battery directly.
risks.proof: Photos of included items: controller/inverter (if any), cables/connectors, and a shot showing the connector type and how it mates to a battery/controller.

risks.risk: Brand/model/serial not verifiable from the visible watermark alone; warranty/receipt claims can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of serial number/QR/warranty card and the receipt (with sensitive details covered).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: send a clear photo of the full product being sold (torch or solar panel) with the model name visible.
Send a close-up photo of the solar module label showing wattage (W), voltage (V), and current (A).
Send full front + full back photos, including edges/corners and the junction/port area.
Send a short working test video showing output under sunlight (meter reading) and/or charging a battery with visible results.
Send photos of any included accessories (controller/inverter, cables, connectors) and show connector compatibility.
Send photos of receipt/warranty card and serial number/QR (cover personal details).
response.reason: The witness photos identify a solar module, while the seller claims a rechargeable LED torch; functional specs and working test results are not visible, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without key proof.
